review: Manual image review by the primary agent and an independent agent, with rendered geometry and keyboard assertions in Chromium.

screenshots.notes: Distinct cell shapes and count cards agree with the capacity bar. Chart labels align with the grid; the current point and readout agree. Playback sits directly below both cards.
All 80 positions are open rings; living counts are zero. Resistant share is undefined and the chart keeps only the initial observed point, without a false zero endpoint.
Legends stack, the unoccupied count fills the last row, and count cards, labels, chart and keyboard focus remain readable without horizontal overflow.
The dish, counts, percentage axis and controls reflow into a readable column. Focus remains visible and rendered percentage labels align with gridlines.
The selected shared round has a yellow border, stronger text and a background that follow the guides in both saved-history charts.
